svg.title: Saberu VPS Takeover — Onboard → Managed → Re-Audit — TARGET (as-designed)

g.text: Saberu VPS Takeover — Onboard → Managed → Re-Audit — TARGET (as-designed)
inject fleet private key → Key Store
fleet public key trusted on target
reuse the run's key — no mounted file)
Phase 3 gate: Re-Audit over managed channel
Recovery: onboard has no auto-rollback — the managed
validation runs BEFORE the bootstrap port is closed, so a
failure leaves root@22 open and the host re-runnable.
